Forty-six people sustained injuries, with both train drivers among those said to be seriously injured, but fatalities were avoided as the trains were travelling at low speeds. Transport minister Ivan Bednárik told local media: "I won't speculate on whether it was a technical fault or a human factor but so far it looks like a train ran a red light." It took around two hours for emergency services to get all passengers off the trains. pages.description: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.
pages.text: DR Congo conflict: At least 66 Congolese soldiers sentenced to death for cowardice Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Weather Newsletters DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards' 8 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Basillioh Rukanga Reuters The Congolese army has been fighting rebels for decades At least 66 soldiers have been sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of Congo for cowardice, mutiny and refusing to obey orders, local media report. The sentences followed a trial of 71 soldiers before a military court in Walikale, in North Kivu province, in eastern DR Congo. Four soldiers were acquitted, while another was sentenced to 10 years in prison. The army said the trial was intended to improve discipline among troops as they battle armed groups in eastern DR Congo. The region has endured decades of conflict, with fighting continuing between government forces and the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), a rebel coalition that includes the M23 group. The soldiers were reportedly arrested on 20 October in Walikale, where they were accused of abandoning their positions and fleeing during clashes with FRN fighters. The Congolese army's campaign against armed groups, including the M23, has long been undermined by poor discipline and disorganisation within its ranks. Dr. Ashley Nunes Dr. Ashley Nunes is Director, Office of Policy at the U.S. Department of Energy. He leads a team that advises the Office of the Secretary on issues related to energy production, job creation, and infrastructure investment. Draco Rosa: Tiny Desk Concert October 13, 2026 7:00 AM ET Felix Contreras Credit: Photo: Zayrha Rodriguez/NPR From jazz and Tejano to norteño and ska, 'El Tiny' returns with a takeover from Sept. 15 to Oct. 15 for Latin Music Month . Draco Rosa 's trajectory from '80s boy band star to enigmatic solo performer music fascinates me to no end. Behind the Desk, Rosa creates shimmering, electric guitar-driven ruminations on life and love. After his tenure in Menudo and some solo success, Rosa went on to produce and co-write some of his former bandmate Ricky Martin 's biggest pop hits, including "Livin' la Vida Loca," "She Bangs" and "The Cup of Life (La Copa de la Vida)." But it was in 1996 that Rosa released what I consider to be one of the best rock en Español albums of all time. Vagabundo spiritually hovers this Tiny Desk performance, culminating in an extended take on the title track's existential themes. Special mention must be made of Puerto Rican jazz trumpeter Charlie Sepulveda, who adds a late-career Miles Davis stamp to the song's climax. NPS Photo The Anniston Civil Rights Heritage Trail project began in 2010. This nine-stop driving tour explores key sites and stories associated with Anniston's civil rights history. To access a PDF version of the tour route, visit the Anniston Civil Rights Trail page on the City of Anniston website. Several stops on the Anniston Civil Rights Heritage Trail directly relate to the Freedom Riders story, including the Anniston Greyhound Bus Depot (1031 Gurnee Avenue) the Anniston Trailways Station (901 Noble Street), and the Anniston Memorial Hospital (corner of 10th and Christine). The remaining stops and their historic markers connect the Freedom Riders to the city of Anniston's larger civil rights story. Together, these nine stops create a powerful learning experience for both area residents and Freedom Riders National Monument visitors. Forensic drug analysis, or seized drug analysis, identifies illegal or controlled materials. The goal of forensic drug analysis is to answer the question, “What is this substance?” Forensic toxicology tests biological samples to determine whether drugs, alcohol or poisons are present. The goal is to answer the question, “What did this person ingest and how much?” What is NIST’s Role? Our experts: Develop and validate tools to quickly analyze seized materials. Create reference materials, reference data and data interpretation tools to help identify new drugs or chemicals in seized materials. Provide near real-time data on the seized drug landscape to support law enforcement and public health agencies. (aka Experience Unlimited) has blessed the Desk. And the timing couldn't be more perfect! In 2026, the official music of Washington, D.C. celebrates 50 years of heavily syncopated funk. Tiny Desk Chuck Brown: Tiny Desk Concert Tiny Desk Trouble Funk: Tiny Desk Concert Tiny Desk Rare Essence: Tiny Desk Concert Go-go features a slow and simple groove, but hidden within are dense polyrhythms and interwoven harmonies. On stage, where go-go thrives, songs bleed into one another and the crowd engages in high-energy call and response, a technique with origins in the Black church. Though many other notable bands deserve recognition, the vanguard four — Chuck Brown , Trouble Funk , Rare Essence and E.U. — are an exemplar of this party music. At the Tiny Desk, each band has brought its own distinct approach to go-go and, here, E.U. plays up its rock and roll edge. You might recognize the last song "Da Butt," which was released as a single from the soundtrack to Spike Lee's 1988 film School Daze. Mining claims for locatable minerals may not be staked on most of these lands, but there are scattered areas in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Florida where mining claims may be staked (or “located”) for hard rock minerals. Public domain lands within BLM Eastern States are not open to the location of mining claims. All Federal minerals are within the jurisdiction of the BLM, whether they may be on public domain or acquired lands. There is, however, one exception: the Ouachita National Forest in Arkansas is authorized to manage quartz mining by contracts under P.L.100-446 Sec.323. For more information, please visit the Forest Service's Minerals & Geology webpage . They regarded the specialised unit as a "death house" as not many patients do recover - especially those admitted in the late stages of the illness. His 50-year-old mother was in tears, pleading with him not to go there. "Why are you choosing to die at the Ebola treatment centre?" Masika Ndungo had asked him. But as a doctor at Butembo's Katwa Hospital, he knew that if stayed at home, he was unlikely to survive. This was in July, two months after the World Health Organization (WHO) had declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a public health emergency of international concern. Since then 5,400 people have died and 11,000 have been infected, making it the second-most deadly outbreak ever recorded. Butembo is in North Kivu province, the epicentre of the crisis, with the highest number of reported cases, according to the Congolese health ministry. Back to climate , updates Ecosystem Vulnerability Data August 24, 2015 Ecosystems are essential to the survival of species and their habitats. They provide life-sustaining services to humans by supplying clean water, food, and other natural resources. The productivity of these ecosystems is being impacted by climate change, threatening the livelihood of those that rely on them. Therefore it has become increasingly important to establish adaptation strategies and improve the resiliency of global ecosystems. Here you can discover and access data, information, and decision tools describing and analyzing ecosystem vulnerability to climate change. The resources address the impacts of climate variability and change on water resources, wildfires, biodiversity, the prevalence of invasive species, and the ability of ecosystems to sequester carbon. pages.text: Edmonia Lewis confronted American slavery in her sculptures. Then history forgot her. | National Geographic Premium HISTORY & CULTURE Edmonia Lewis confronted American slavery in her sculptures. Then history forgot her. A new exhibition of her masterworks is traveling the country and reclaiming her place in American history. During her lifetime, Edmonia Lewis was America's most famous artists. Seen here, the biracial sculptor defied the odds and produced trailblazing work. Augustus Marshall, Courtesy Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture By Katy Kelleher Published June 15, 2026 Part celebrity, part anomaly, sculptor Edmonia Lewis captivated mid-19 th -century audiences with her luminous, large-scale marble sculptures that appeared nearly lifelike in their carefully rendered detail. For wealthy Americans on the Grand Tour, a stop at her studio was practically necessary. But visitors weren’t just there to follow in the footsteps of Pope Pius IX and President Ulysses S. Grant, both admirers of Lewis, they were there to obtain proof. They wanted to see with their own eyes that Lewis, a petite biracial woman, could render life from stone. For some, it beggared belief that her hands could have coaxed forth vivid expressions from blocks of Carrara marble. While she was able to delegate some of the brute work of carving to assistants, Lewis made a point of ensuring that the public saw her with a chisel in hand, an unusual choice for sculptors of the era. Not all fish, shellfish, or the insects that they eat can tolerate the same amount of acid. An ecosystem is a community of plants, animals and other organisms along with their environment including the air, water and soil. Everything in an ecosystem is connected. If something harms one part of an ecosystem – one species of plant or animal, the soil or the water – it can have an impact on everything else. Effects of Acid Rain on Fish and Wildlife The ecological effects of acid rain are most clearly seen in aquatic environments, such as streams, lakes, and marshes where it can be harmful to fish and other wildlife. As it flows through the soil, acidic rain water can leach aluminum from soil clay particles and then flow into streams and lakes. pages.text: EFTPS：联邦电子缴税系统 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS：联邦电子缴税系统 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 您的在线账户 银行账户 (Direct Pay) 借记卡或信用卡 您的在线账户 企业税付款（联邦电子缴税系统 (EFTPS)） 付款计划 税务债务帮助 罚款 利息 预扣税（英文） 国外电子付款 用户费用（英文） 不再接受新的个人纳税人注册 个人纳税人不能再创建新的联电子缴税系统 (EFTPS) 账户。大多数个人税款通过您的 在线账户 支付。对于不太常见的支付类型，“ 直接支付 ”现在接受 更多表格 的支付。现有的 EFTPS 用户仍然可以使用 EFTPS。 EFTPS (英文) 是由美国财政部提供用来缴纳您的联邦税的免费系统。 EFTPS 提供 您可以信赖的安全性 使用您的纳税人识别号码（ EIN 或 SSN ）、个人识别号码 （ PIN ） 和互联网密码，以及安全的互联网浏览器，可提高您的安全性。 触手可及的便利 提前 365 天来安排付款。 您可以一周七天，一天 24 小时从家里或办公室进行缴税。 缴付所得税、就业税、预估税和工商联邦税。 轻松更改或取消设定的付款。 通过电子邮件通知追踪您的付款。 查看 15 个月的付款历史记录。 向客户服务部了解付款帮助，或洽询问题。 您可以信赖的准确性 您的付款会收到立即确认，您的银行对帐单将确认付款已支付。 能够为多个客户付款 如果您是税务专业人士，您可以在一次登录下为多个客户付款。 下载免费的批量提供商软件（英文） 。 5301号刊物，联邦电子缴税系统 -- 批量提供商软件用户手册（英文） PDF 如何注册EFTPS EFTPS 的新注册最多可能需要五个工作日才能处理。 在 EFTPS 注册（英文） 或向 EFTPS 客户服务部索取注册登记表格： 800-555-4477 877-333-8292 (联邦政府机构) 800-733-4829 ( TDD 听障专线) 800-244-4829 (西班牙语) 使用 EFTPS 的额外好处 通过 EFTPS 语音回复系统付款选项： 800-555-3453 使用 常见问题（ FAQ ）(英文) 功能获得即时资讯 注册后，可使用 "如何"(英文) 功能（需要注册） 下载 EFTPS 文档 (英文) （如果页面显示"时限过期"，请重新单击或重新下载） 更多资讯如下 966号刊物 -《联邦电子缴税系统：入门指南》 (英文) PDF 4990号刊物 -《企业与个人纳税人的 EFTPS 付款指示小册》(英文) PDF 5301，联邦电子缴税系统 -- 批量提供商软件用户手册 (英文) PDF EFTPS ®在线资源，可通过电话订购(英文) 付款主页 上的更多电子和其他付款选项 目前冒充国税局的诈骗和钓鱼网站 Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 10-Nov-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print

pages.description: 전자식 연방세 납부 시스템(EFTPS)은 미국 재무부에서 납세자의 연방 세금 납부를 위해 무료로 제공하는 시스템입니다. EFTPS에 대한 설명과 사용방법에 대해 알아보십시오.
pages.text: EFTPS：전자 연방세 납부 시스템 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS：전자 연방세 납부 시스템 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 지불 은행 계좌 직불 또는 신용카드 귀하의 온라인 계정 사업세 납부 (EFTPS) 지불 계획 세금 채무 도움말 과태료 이자 세금 원천징수 해외 전자 납부 사용자 수수료 (영어) ​ 개인 납세자 신규 등록 불가 개인 납세자는 더 이상 새 EFTPS 계정을 생성할 수 없습니다. 대부분의 개인 세금은 온라인 계정 을 통해 납부하십시오. 일반적이지 않은 납부 유형의 경우 이제 Direct Pay 에서 추가 서식 에 대한 납부를 받습니다. 현재 EFTPS 사용자는 당분간 여전히 EFTPS를 사용할 수 있습니다 EFTPS (영어) 는 미국 재무부에서 납세자의 연방 세금 납부를 위해 제공하는 무료 시스템입니다. EFTPS 는 다음을 제공합니다: 신뢰할 수 있는 보안 안전한 인터넷 브라우저에서 납세자 식별 번호 ( EIN 또는 SSN ), 개인 식별 번호 ( PIN ) 및 인터넷 암호, 그리고 안전한 인터넷 브라우저를 병용하여 보안이 강화됩니다. 언제든 이용 가능한 편리성 납부일을 365일 까지 미리 예약할 수 있습니다. 집이나 사무실에서 언제든지 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 소득, 고용, 연방세 중간예납 및 연방 특별 소비세를 납부할 수 있습니다. 예약된 세금 납부를 쉽게 변경하거나 취소할 수 있습니다. 이메일 알림으로 납부 상황을 추적할 수 있습니다. 지난 15개월 동안의 납부 내역을 확인할 수 있습니다. 고객 서비스 안내원으로부터 납부 또는 질문에 대한 도움을 받을 수 있습니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 정확성 귀하의 납부에 대한 즉각적 확인 내역과 귀하의 은행 명세서를 검토하여 납부 사실을 확인할 수 있습니다. 다수의 고객의 세금 납부를 할 수 있는 수용력 세무 전문가는, 단일 로그인으로 다수 고객의 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 무료 Batch Provider Software (일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어)를 다운로드하십시오(영어) . 간행물 5301, 전자 연방 세금 납부 시스템 – 일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어 사용자 매뉴얼(영어) PDF EFTPS 등록 방법 신규 EFTPS 등록은 업무일수로 최대 5일이 소요됩니다. EFTPS 에서 가입(영어) 하거나 EFTPS 고객 서비스에 가입 양식을 요청하십시오: 800-555-4477 877-333-8292 (연방 기관) 800-733-4829 (청각 장애인을 위한 TDD 전화) 800-244-4829 (스페인어) EFTPS 사용 시 추가 이점 EFTPS 음성 응답 시스템 ( 800-555-3453 )으로도 납부할 수 있습니다. 자주 묻는 질문(영어) 을 이용하여 즉각적인 정보 이용이 가능합니다. 회원가입 이후 사용방법(영어) 기능을 사용할 수 있습니다(가입자에게만 해당).
